News Releases

FERC and NRC Commissioners to Discuss Grid Reliability, Nuclear Power, and Cybersecurity at Joint Meeting

October 15, 2026

Share on Twitter

Share on Facebook

Share on LinkedIn

Share via E-mail

Print This Page

Docket No. AD06-6-000 | 
Event Details
 | 
Webcast Link
The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) and the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) will hold a joint public meeting at NRC Headquarters to discuss current issues, including grid reliability, managing load increases, operating and new nuclear power plants, and cyber security. 
Staff from both agencies and the North American Electric Reliability Corporation will brief the NRC and FERC Commissioners at the meeting, continuing a tradition of regular joint meetings between the two agencies going back two decades.
The joint meeting will be held on October 22, 2026, from 1:00 to 3:30 p.m. at NRC Headquarters, located at 11555 Rockville Pike in Rockville, Maryland.
The public is invited to attend in person or watch live via webcast at 
video.nrc.gov
.
